children: Overview
UK embedded computing maker's H1 2026 revenue grew 10% yr/yr, profit before tax up 19%
Order intake for H1 2026 surged 110%, matching prior full-year total
Company expects FY26 revenue and profit to exceed market expectations, citing record contract win
Outlook
Concurrent expects FY26 revenue to be materially ahead of market expectations
Company sees FY26 profit ahead of market expectations, driven by profit recognition on a record contract
Company expects H2 2026 gross margin percentage to be lower due to contract mix
Result Drivers
ORDER MOMENTUM - H1 order intake rose 110% to £46.9m, driven by demand across key markets and a record contract win, providing increased revenue visibility
DESIGN WIN CONVERSIONS - Continued conversion of earlier design wins into production programmes and further design wins secured, enhancing long-term revenue visibility
SYSTEMS BUSINESS PROFITABILITY - Systems division delivered its first profitable half, benefiting from improved revenue mix and integration of Phillips Aerospace acquisition
